decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (81/02/101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, location plan, block plan received 18/11/2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Prior to occupation of the unit hereby approved, a refuse store to match the existing refuse stores on the forecourts of the adjoin flats in this block shall be installed in the area to the front of the building in a comparable location.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until details of the cycle parking to be provided as part of the development hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Erection of two rear roof extensions to allow for roof space to be converted into a flat with arched window to front elevation
